briefdescription.para: Case entity for the patients_visitdrugs table (drugs recorded for a visit).

detaileddescription.para: This header declares the VisitDrugs class, a small C++ type that stands for the drugs recorded for one visit in the patients_visitdrugs database table. Despite the table name starting with patients_, ownership is resolved through the visit (the create payload carries a visit id). The class itself holds no data; it names the table and leaves SQL generation to its parent Case. It also supplies small helper functions that build permission-checking SQL for create, read, update and delete operations.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: VisitDrugs is one of the clinic-owned "case" types exposed through the clinic routes as ClinicController<VisitDrugs> under the visitDrugs service type. When a client wants to add or change a visit's drugs, PermissionManager calls the static getPermissionsQueryFor* helpers here to build a SELECT that finds which clinic owns the visit (via clinics_visits), then checks whether the requesting user is that clinic's owner, admin or staff. Without this file there would be no C++ type connecting the patients_visitdrugs table to the CRUD and permission machinery, so visit-drug endpoints could not work.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
static constexpr: a value fixed at compile time that belongs to the class, not to one object. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/static
JSON: a text format used to carry request data; this project uses the jsoncons library to read it. https://jsoncons.github.io/jsoncons/
Foreign key: a column that points to a row in another table, used here to trace a record back to its owning visit and then to the owning clinic. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp
